issues.description: Return type mismatch for messageOnMilk(): The problem statement (UML and textual description) and the template's Main usage expect Milkable.messageOnMilk() to return a String (e.g., "[Animal Type] [name] is milked"), but the solution defines Milkable.messageOnMilk() to return a boolean and the Goat/Seal implementations print the message and return true. This structural conflict will confuse students and prevents following the specified design (Main prints the returned value and the UML specifies a String).
issues.suggestedFix: Align the solution with the problem specification and template: change Milkable.messageOnMilk() to return String, and update Seal and Goat to return the formatted String ("[Animal Type] [name] is milked") instead of printing and returning a boolean. Ensure any code that calls messageOnMilk() (e.g., Main) prints or uses the returned String as intended.
